title: arenaria holostea var. pubescens
intro: Arenaria holostea var. pubescens, commonly known as the hairy alpine carnation, is a plant species that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae) and is native to Europe and Asia. The hairy alpine carnation is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as a diuretic, making it a popular remedy for urinary tract problems. The bioactive constituents of Arenaria holostea var. pubescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
